rca of the issue: Iteration 3 bug root cause: auth fetch was gated inside `if (sessionMode === 'voice')` so text mode fell through to plain-agentId WS which ElevenLabs immediately closed. Fix (verified this iteration): the fetch is now unconditional and returns signed_url for text / conversation_token for voice; text mode calls startSession({ signedUrl }) which succeeds and delivers the first agent turn.
